Overview of Available Roles and Employers

A cross-section of community and social services employment opportunities has been detailed through professional listing channels for the Des Moines, Iowa metropolitan area. The available positions span behavioral health, case management, youth programs, and direct support care, offered by a variety of healthcare providers, state agencies, and non-profit organizations.

Notable employers featured in the regional listings include UnityPoint Health, Catholic Charities Diocese of Des Moines, MercyOne, Trinity Health, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Primary Health Care, Inc., and the State of Iowa Executive Branch. Specific positions identified range from Behavioral Health Navigators and Case Managers to Social Workers, Substance Abuse Counselors, and Regional Directors of Community Health.

Practical Implications and Role Requirements

For professionals seeking employment in the social services and healthcare sectors, the local market presents diverse opportunities across multiple sub-fields:

  • Behavioral and Mental Health: Roles such as Behavioral Health Navigator, School Based Mental Health Therapist, and Substance Abuse Counselor require specialized clinical or counseling backgrounds.
  • Case Management: Positions like Case Manager and LTSS Service Coordinator focus on coordinating client care across various regional providers.
  • Direct Support and Care: Direct Support Professionals (DSPs), Residential Treatment Counselors, and Behavior Technicians support daily living and specialized developmental programs.

What is Confirmed Versus Unknown

Confirmed Details:

  • The listings represent active or recently posted opportunities located within Des Moines and surrounding communities such as West Des Moines, Urbandale, Johnston, Ankeny, and Altoona.
  • Multiple organizations, ranging from hospital networks to state branches and non-profits, are currently recruiting for social services personnel.

Unspecified Details:

  • Salary: Not specified across the listings.
  • Eligibility Criteria: Specific degree, licensure, or experience prerequisites are generally not detailed in the summary view.
  • Deadlines: Application deadlines are not specified.
  • Selection Process: Interview stages and hiring workflows are not detailed.
  • Application Steps: Specific submission procedures beyond platform redirection are not provided.

How Readers Can Verify and Apply

Readers interested in reviewing individual role descriptions, checking exact geographic locations, or submitting application materials can access the primary source platform. Because compensation, exact qualifications, and application windows vary widely by organization, applicants should consult the official job postings directly on the [LinkedIn Community and Social Services Jobs in Des Moines](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/community-and-social-services-jobs-des-moines-ia) portal.
